description: Defines an abstract base class 'FieldRenderer' for rendering fields into RTF format within the MigraDoc document generation library. The class provides methods for starting and ending RTF fields and a virtual method to get the field result.

classes.name: FieldRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class for rendering fields in RTF documents, providing basic methods to handle RTF field control words and results.

methods.name: StartField
methods.description: Initializes an RTF field with appropriate control words, starting the content and inserting control commands for a field.

methods.name: EndField
methods.description: Closes the RTF field by writing the field result and ending the content blocks.

methods.name: GetFieldResult
methods.description: Returns the current value of the field result, defaulting to a message indicating the field needs to be updated.
